title: Define addressable inline option IDs for SRD choices
description:
Combined vk23 audit follow-up.

The vk23 pack models several gameplay-significant options as inline structured choices rather than first-class records. This is reasonable for source fidelity, but deterministic tools and retrieval need an explicit addressing contract.

Concrete example:
- Eldritch Invocation prerequisites reference inline Pact Boon option IDs:
  - pact-boon:pact-of-the-tome
  - pact-boon:pact-of-the-chain
  - pact-boon:pact-of-the-blade
- These are not top-level records; they exist under feature:warlock:pact-boon.

Similar categories may include Fighting Styles, Metamagic options, Hunter options, Pact Boons, Eldritch Invocations, and other feature-local choices.

Acceptance criteria:
- Decide whether gameplay-significant inline options should remain nested addressable entities or be promoted to first-class records.
- If nested: define a stable address format and add resolver/index support so deterministic tools can resolve inline option IDs.
- If first-class: generate records for the selected option categories and update references accordingly.
- Add tests that Warlock invocation prerequisites resolve successfully.
- Add an audit check that reference-like fields pointing to inline option IDs are either resolvable or explicitly exempted with rationale.
close_reason: Kept inline options nested; added inlineFeatureOptions.ts resolver/index plus unresolvable-inline-option-ref audit gate. All Warlock invocation prerequisites verified resolvable against the committed pack
